title: Coherent module families are small via a point-indexed subcover
statement: For a ringed space X in universe u, a cover U indexed by any I in universe w, local module sheaves Fi with section universe max u v, and arbitrary overlap isomorphisms φij, the coherent-family submodule of def-weil-pbc-module-compatible-family-presheaf on every open V is small in universe max u v. No diagonal or cocycle identities are needed.

source.place: Tags 00AL (first proof) and 00AM; point-indexed universe argument of parent node

proof.text: Choose an index c(x) through each point using the open-cover hypothesis. Encode a coherent family by all its components on subopens of U c(x) contained in V. This is a product indexed by pairs of points and opens, hence in universe max u v.

For injectivity, fix an original component on W. The sieve of subopens contained in some chosen member covers W: through x in W use W intersect U c(x). On this sieve, overlap coherence identifies the original component with a chosen component, so two equally encoded families agree. Separation of Fi on the over-site gives equality on W. Function extensionality and small_of_injective finish, including the empty space.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_open_module_small
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (I : Type w) (U : I → Opens X)
  (Fi : ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.{max u v} ((moduleRings X).over (U i)))
  (φij : ∀ i j : I,
    (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj (Fi i) ≅
    (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
      (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj (Fi j))
    (hcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (V : Opens X) :
    Small.{max u v} (coherentOpenModuleSubmodule X I U Fi φij V)
